s: Today we talk about sports and playtime.
I run in the park near my house.
I cannot run fast, but I like to walk.
Sometimes I run with my friend Tom.
Running is a happy time for me.
I want to run like you one day.
Do you play any games too?
I play basketball with my brother.
We play after work every day.
Is your brother good at the game?
The game is easy for him.
The game is hard for me.
The best part is to play together.
Do you play with a ball?
The ball is old but good.
Sometimes the ball goes over the fence.
Does your brother get the ball back?
Yes, he jumps and gets the ball.
He wants to win every game.
I also want to win when I play a game.
My brother can run faster than me, so he can win the race to the ball.
Every time you play, you get better.
I want to win one game this month.
When I run in the morning, I feel strong.
Do you want to run with me one day?
But I will not run fast.
We can run slow and talk.
The important thing is to play and have fun.
A game does not always need a winner.
But a small win feels good.
When you win, you smile all day.
When I finish my run, I smile too.
Let me tell you about last Saturday.
We had a big game in the park.
Did you have a good ball for the game?
The ball was white and blue.
Everyone wanted to touch the ball.
And did your team win the game?
We did not win, but we laughed a lot.
To play with friends is better than to win alone.
Sport is about friends, not just the win.
After the game, we sat on the grass.
My legs hurt from the long run.
Next time, maybe you will win.
If I run every morning like you, I will be faster and I can win.
Keep running, keep playing, and enjoy every game you play.
Sports time is the best time.
Let us play again next week.
And to everyone listening, find a ball, find a friend, and play today.
Keep running, keep playing, and enjoy the game.
When I run in the morning, I eat a big breakfast after.
After I play a game with my brother, I drink a lot of water.
Water is the best drink after a run.
Do you eat fruit before you play?
Then I can run faster and play longer.
What is your favorite game of all time?
I love basketball, but I also love football.
A football game is long, but the ball is fun to kick.
A football game with friends on a sunny day is the best.
Do you want to play football this Sunday?
We can play in the park.
And we can run a little first.
We will run, then play, and maybe our team will win.
If we play well, we can win.
But even if we do not win, we will have fun.
That is the right way to think.
So, friends, remember our five words today.
Try to win, but smile always.
That was a lovely sports day.
Thanks for listening to Word Kitchen.
